description: This file defines a Java interface 'BatchFilter' which is part of the Fineract project. It specifies a method for filtering batch requests, interacting with BatchRequest, BatchResponse, and BatchFilterChain classes.

classes.name: BatchFilter
classes.description: An interface defining a filter for batch requests within the Fineract infrastructure.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Filters a batch request, returning a BatchResponse. It takes a BatchRequest, UriInfo, and a BatchFilterChain as parameters.
